title: Resveratrol improves meat quality traits by activating the lncRNAs-KEAP1-NRF2 axis in pigs.
authors: Zhang, Sanbao; Pan, Peng; Xie, Hongyue; Wei, Chongwan; Wang, Qian; Yang, Bao; Sun, Yanjie; Li, Yin; Luo, Yunyan; Song, Ying; Jiang, Qinyang; Huang, Yanna
one_liner_zh: 研究白藜芦醇通过lncRNA-KEAP1-NRF2轴改善猪肉品质，涉及KEAP1-NRF2蛋白互作的分子动力学模拟，但核心是抗氧化通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或DNA结合建模方法。
abstract: This research aims at uncovering the effects and investigating the molecular mechanisms of dietary resveratrol (RES) supplementation on antioxidant capacity and meat quality of pigs. In this study, 20 muM RES could activate the KEAP1-NRF2 antioxidant defense pathway in response to oxidative stress in porcine skeletal muscle satellite cells was firstly found. Then, twenty-four healthy crossbred castrated boars were allocated to 4 treatments that were fed with a basal diet (control) and a basal diet supplemented with 200 mg, 400 mg or 600 mg RES per Kilogram (kg) of feed for 41 days, respectively. 400 and 600 mg/kg RES-supplemented diet can effectively improve the meat quality traits and activities of antioxidizing enzymes via the KEAP1-NRF2 signaling pathway of pigs. The molecular dynamic simulation further revealed that RES could directly binding to KEAP1 to reduce the tightness of KEAP1-NRF2 protein-protein interaction. More importantly, dietary supplementation of RES also improves antioxidant capacity through a series of KEAP1-NRF2 pathway-related lncRNAs were found by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq). Altogether, this study demonstrated that RES improves meat quality traits by effectively increasing antioxidant levels via the lncRNA-KEAP1-NRF2 axis in vivo and/or in vitro. These results provide new insights into the molecular mechanisms by which RES, as a nutritional agent, regulates antioxidant capacity and improves meat quality in pigs.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在揭示膳食白藜芦醇（RES） supplementation对猪抗氧化能力和肉品质的影响，并探讨其分子机制。本研究首先发现，20 μM RES能够激活猪骨骼肌卫星细胞中KEAP1-NRF2抗氧化防御通路以应对氧化应激。随后，将二十四头健康的杂交去势公猪随机分为4个处理组，分别饲喂基础日粮（对照组）及在基础日粮中添加200 mg、400 mg或600 mg RES每千克（kg）饲料，持续41天。400和600 mg/kg RES补充日粮能通过KEAP1-NRF2信号通路有效改善猪的肉品质性状和抗氧化酶活性。分子动力学模拟进一步揭示，RES可直接与KEAP1结合，降低KEAP1-NRF2蛋白-蛋白相互作用的紧密性。更重要的是，通过RNA测序（RNA-seq）发现，膳食RES补充还通过一系列与KEAP1-NRF2通路相关的lncRNAs提高抗氧化能力。总之，本研究证明，RES通过lncRNA-KEAP1-NRF2轴在体内和/或体外有效提高抗氧化水平，从而改善肉品质性状。这些结果为RES作为营养剂调控猪抗氧化能力和改善肉品质的分子机制提供了新见解。
